headline_hi: कैबिनेट ने नए परिवहन प्राधिकरण और 10,000 करोड़ रुपये के MSME फंड को मंजूरी दी
summary: The Indian Cabinet approved the proposal to establish the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority. The Indian Union Cabinet also approved a 10,000 crore rupee growth fund for the MSME sector.

headline_en: Supreme Court will consider application to recall split verdict

summary: The Supreme Court of India said it would consider an application seeking the recall of its September 23 split verdict. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that the Supreme Court will examine and take a call on the recall application.

headline_en: Uttar Pradesh Police photograph and fingerprint Umesh Pal murder accused in Gaya

summary: Uttar Pradesh Police personnel from Dhumanganj police station visited Gaya Central Jail and photographed and fingerprinted accused Arman.

headline_en: BJP replaces seven sitting members with eight new Rajya Sabha candidates

summary: The BJP announced the names of eight candidates for the Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh on Monday 05 October 2026. BJP is deliberating on the names of eight candidates for the Rajya Sabha elections in Uttar Pradesh on Monday 05 October 2026.

headline_en: DRDO successfully flight tests indigenous high-altitude platform at 21 kilometers
headline_hi: DRDO ने 21 किलोमीटर की ऊंचाई पर स्वदेशी हाई-एल्टीट्यूड प्लेटफॉर्म का सफलतापूर्वक उड़ान परीक्षण किया
summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation conducted a successful flight test of the indigenous High Altitude Platform on Tuesday, 6 October 2026.

headline_en: Telangana Congress asks Hyderabad police to investigate alleged mass voter deletion

summary: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy directed district election officers on Monday to take action against applicants who knowingly make false statements or declarations in electoral forms.

headline_en: Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute researcher Darya Shipilova dies after pneumonia hospitalisation
headline_hi: इरकुत्स्क एंटी-प्लेग इंस्टीट्यूट की शोधकर्ता डारिया शपिलोवा निमोनिया के अस्पताल में भर्ती होने के बाद मर जाती हैं
summary: Global warming is causing permafrost in Siberia to melt, potentially reviving ancient bacteria and viruses.

headline_en: Defence Ministry signs Rs 661.50 crore BrahMos systems deal
headline_hi: रक्षा मंत्रालय ने 661.50 करोड़ रुपये के ब्रह्मोस सिस्टम सौदे पर हस्ताक्षर किए
summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a defense deal with BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited for purchasing fire control systems and missile launchers on 6 October 2026.

headline_en: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey agree to deploy forces in Riyadh
headline_hi: पाकिस्तान, सऊदी अरब और तुर्की रियाद में सेना तैनात करने पर सहमत हुए
summary: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey held an emergency meeting of their defense alliance in Riyadh on Monday, where the three countries agreed to implement collective defense commitments and deploy military forces to Saudi Arabia.

headline_en: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel win 2026 Nobel Prize

summary: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel were awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine on October 05, 2026, for their discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics. The Nobel Assembly announced the prize on October 5, 2026.

headline_en: Opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi reportedly marched toward Election Commission headquarters
headline_hi: राहुल गांधी के नेतृत्व में विपक्षी सांसदों ने कथित तौर पर चुनाव आयोग मुख्यालय की ओर मार्च किया
summary: Opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi staged a march from Parliament towards the Election Commission headquarters on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

headline_en: Authorities reportedly recover pistols, grenades and ammunition from arrested individuals

summary: Kulgam police, 9RR, and 18 Battalion CRPF arrested five individuals in Kulgam on Wednesday 07 October 2026. Police registered a case at Kulgam police station on Wednesday 07 October 2026.

summary: A Sub-Inspector and Station House Officer of Maker Police Station pointed a gun at flood victims and showed them footwear during the distribution of relief materials.

headline_en: Delhi Traffic Police divert Barapullah Phase-3 traffic toward NH-24 and DND
headline_hi: दिल्ली ट्रैफिक पुलिस ने बारापुल्ला फेज-3 के ट्रैफिक को NH-24 और DND की ओर डायवर्ट किया
summary: Delhi Traffic Police diverted traffic from Barapullah Phase-3 towards NH-24/DND.

headline_en: Mayawati reinstates Akash Anand and appoints Ishan Anand as BSP coordinators

summary: Bahujan Samaj Party chief Mayawati reinstated Akash Anand as the party's National Coordinator, and appointed Ishan Anand as the National Coordinator of the BSP on Monday 05 October 2026.

headline_en: Student loses hand after picking up grenade during French school protests

summary: The Gomti River in Lucknow flooded, and the Gomti River water level of the Gomti River in Lucknow is rising.

headline_en: AAP Sarpanch Ashwani Kumar reportedly shot by unknown attackers in Patti

summary: Navtej Singh, a 55-year-old former sarpanch, was shot dead by unidentified assailants in Ludhiana on Sunday 04 October 2026.

headline_en: Drone reportedly strikes oil tanker Aframax Rio in Black Sea

headline_hi: भारत ने काला सागर में टोगो-ध्वज वाले जहाज पर कथित हमले की निंदा की
summary: Commercial maritime traffic in the Black Sea has faced assaults since the onset of the Russia-Ukraine conflict in 2022. The ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict has created a dangerous environment for merchant vessels in the Black Sea.

summary: External affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated on Wednesday that India has sought an update from Russian authorities on the whereabouts of 69 Indian nationals.

headline_en: Maharashtra government accepts key demands of protesting tribal students

summary: Maharashtra Tribal Development Minister Ashok Uike announced that the government has accepted the key demands of tribal students.

summary: A multi-storey building collapsed in New Seemapuri, northeast Delhi, on Wednesday afternoon.

headline_en: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launches fleet support ship Surya in Visakhapatnam

headline_en: Retired judges criticize Supreme Court Justice Ujjal Bhuyan's remarks on voter rights

The Supreme Court is hearing pleas challenging a new law governing the appointment of election commissioner

headline_en: Delhi Police reportedly detain Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi during Jantar Mantar protest
headline_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस ने कथित तौर पर जंतर-मंतर विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान राहुल और प्रियंका गांधी को हिरासत में लिया
summary: India Block leaders and supporters held a protest near Jantar Mantar on Wednesday. Delhi Police detained 91 people during the protest.

headline_en: Bombay High Court reportedly orders state affidavit on 70,000 vacant posts
headline_hi: बॉम्बे हाईकोर्ट ने कथित तौर पर 70,000 रिक्त पदों पर राज्य का हलफनामा तलब किया
